title: GM-GReFEL: Geometry-Guided Spatiotemporal State-Space Learning for Robust Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.31140v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recognizing facial expressions in unconstrained video suffers from two coupled problems: self-attention grows quadratically in cost with clip length, and crowdsourced labels are noisy. We present GM-GReFEL, a spatiotemporal state-space network with a geometry-aware decision stage. Its Modulated GroupMamba backbone replaces a spatiotemporal Vision Transformer. Six channel groups are scanned separately, four over the frame plane and two over time, so the cost grows linearly with sequence length ($\mathcal{O}(N)$); after each layer, a Channel Affinity Modulation gate mixes the groups again. On top of the backbone, a GReFEL reliability module turns the normalized entropy of each prediction into a mixing weight between the classifier output and a vote from trainable geometric anchors, so that facial geometry counts for more when the network is unsure. The model is initialized by static-to-dynamic weight transfer and trained with a Triple Lo

translated_title: GM-GReFEL：面向鲁棒动态面部表情识别的几何引导时空状态空间学习
translated_abstract: 在无约束视频中进行面部表情识别面临两个相互耦合的问题：自注意力的计算成本随视频片段长度呈二次方增长，以及众包标签存在噪声。我们提出了GM-GReFEL，一种带有几何感知决策阶段的时空状态空间网络。其调制型GroupMamba骨干网络取代了时空视觉Transformer。六个通道组被分别扫描，其中四个在帧平面上扫描，两个沿时间维度扫描，因此计算成本随序列长度线性增长（O(N)）；在每层之后，通道亲和调制门控会重新混合这些通道组。在骨干网络之上，GReFEL可靠性模块将每个预测的归一化熵转换为分类器输出与可训练几何锚点投票之间的混合权重，使得当网络不确定时，面部几何信息能发挥更大作用。该模型通过静态到动态的权重迁移进行初始化，并采用三重损失进行训练。
tldr: 提出GM-GReFEL模型，通过线性复杂度的时空状态空间骨干网络与基于面部几何锚点的可靠性决策模块，同时解决了动态面部表情识别中自注意力计算开销大和众包标签噪声两大难题。
en_tdlr: GM-GReFEL proposes a linear-complexity spatiotemporal state-space backbone combined with a geometry-anchored reliability decision module, jointly addressing the high computational cost of self-attention and the label noise in dynamic facial expression recognition.
